_comment: Reproducible example set for the drop-channel ablation of Appendix C. FULL = parent code + the natural-language idea 'prefer least remaining slack' + scores; ABLATED = parent code + scores only (idea removed). Each entry is a priority(item, bins) heuristic the operator could emit under that condition. On the easy online-BPP task both conditions reach the optimum, so the NL channel is not load-bearing here. Regenerate with a real model via llm.AnthropicLLM to run your own ablation.
